scope: H1-H2 substrate causality; H3 access signatures only; no phenomenal inference

H1.question: Autonomous field-mediated propagation under synaptic blockade
H1.primary_observable: probability of propagation across a verified complete cut, per preparation
H1.planned_contrast: propagation under blockade minus propagation with opposition field, paired per preparation

H2.question: Propagation gain versus extracellular volume fraction
H2.primary_observable: within-preparation propagation probability or speed versus measured volume fraction
H2.direction: reduced volume fraction facilitates propagation; increased fraction impedes it

H3.question: Intervention on field coupling gain and local level-IV signatures
H3.primary_observable: predefined local access-signature change under gain intervention versus sham
